hardening.review_mode_required: Every decision row must disclose review_mode; verified evidence may not be silently manual/model assisted.
hardening.official_regulator_policy: OFFICIAL_REGULATOR must use a government/official institutional domain ending in .gov, .gov.uk, .europa.eu or another explicitly reviewed government TLD/domain documented in verification_reason.
hardening.official_court_policy: OFFICIAL_COURT must use a court/government domain or an explicitly documented official judiciary domain; nonofficial aggregators cannot satisfy VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_TRUTH.
hardening.issuer_ir_policy: ISSUER_IR remains issuer-domain specific and therefore cannot use a global suffix allowlist; review_mode and verification_reason must explicitly identify the issuer/IR authority.

unchanged: unresolved/rejected/not-historical rows excluded from verified N
